classification: tooling defects found by static review before first execution; no scientific result was produced or lost
review_context: The draft was written at the end of the previous session but never compiled, prechecked, smoked or queued. Frozen-input gate PASS (12 items, contract v4, P4 running) and pinned DCGS 5e0e4c73f1d0e8e17d81befa24ff947deec1f4be were re-verified before this review.

defects.description: naiveif_forward reimplemented GatedGCNLayer by calling layer.A(h), layer.B(h), layer.C(e), layer.D(h)[src], layer.E(h)[dst] directly, bypassing the author's GatedGCNLayer.forward(edge_index, h, e) which also owns bn_node_e, dropout, global_mean_pool and the MLP head's own F.relu calls. A hand-rewritten forward cannot be claimed faithful to the frozen teacher.
defects.repair: Register forward hooks on the exact ten stage-1 capture sites (bn_node_h, bn_node_e, FC_layers[0], FC_layers[1]) and call the author's model(batch) unchanged. The author's F.relu is an identity on the returned non-negative spike train. A no-op-hook bitwise fidelity check against the uninstrumented forward is now mandatory.

defects.description: LabelFreeDataset strips y from every converter batch, but the label fallback used ds[bi*BATCH_SIZE].y.numpy().reshape(1), producing ONE label for a whole 128-graph batch; concatenation would never match the logits length.
defects.repair: Read labels from the ORIGINAL dataset through a separate DataLoader in the same fixed order, and require bitwise equality with canonical-baseline-val.npz labels before any model pass.

defects.description: --limit smoke wrote into the canonical OUT/seedN directory; the later full-split run would be refused by the existing-dir guard, or a smoke report could be mistaken for evidence.
defects.repair: --limit now writes to logs/e2_naiveif_eval_smoke_v1/seedN and is labelled smoke_probe_not_evidence; verify refuses anything but full-split canonical reports.

defects.description: coverage.graphs used the vacuous expression sum(len(o['indices'][0]) for o in []) or sum(len(x) for x in ...), which silently depended on a loop variable and was not an explicit graph counter.
defects.repair: Use an explicit total_graphs counter accumulated per batch and require it to equal 5000 on a full run.

unchanged_scientific_parameters.threshold_source: all 45000 official train graphs, per-channel max positive pre-activation, label-free

added_hard_gates: canonical indices and labels bitwise equal before any GPU pass
seed41 teacher logits bitwise equal to canonical reference on first batch
no-op-hook instrumented forward bitwise equal to uninstrumented frozen forward
all ten IF sites touched at every T
processed data hashes checked before and after
NPZ schema, indices and labels rechecked bitwise in verify
note: Raw draft bytes are preserved here with SHA-256. The repaired script is e2_naiveif_eval_v1.py. No published checkpoint, manifest or immutable artifact was edited.
